text.description_html:
Schlage F58CAMF59CAM, Traditional Camelot Handleset with Camelot Interior Trim Rosettes

The Camelot Handleset with Matching Interior Trim is a full matching set. The distinctive design of the Camelot combines architectural inspired arches with graceful curves. The two-piece design offers flexibility for doors with non-standard hole locations while providing a classic appearance for smaller entranceways. A fine example for the legendary quality and reliability Schlage has come to be known for, it is made with a rugged all-metal chassis for added security. What is more, the Camelot Handleset is gorgeous, featuring beveled edged mounting plates that look great for traditional styled homes. Available in dummy function or single cylinder function.

Features of the Schlage Camelot Handleset:

  • ANSI A156.5 Grade 1 security for the Single Cylinder Function.
  • All metal chassis for strength and durability.
  • 3 screw door frame reinforcer.
  • C keyway comes packaged with 2 keys for the Single Cylinder Function.
  • Outside Trim: Handlesets are solid forged brass; wrought brass trim rings with concealed security inserts.
  • Inside Trim: are zinc-based plated to match finishes indicated.
  • Easy installation.
  • Will fit most standard door preparations.
  • Adjustable through bolt can move up and down 1-1/2" to fit a variety of pre-existing holes

Specifications of the Camelot Handleset:

  • Rage of Door Preparation: 4" to 5-1/2"
  • Exterior Total Height: 18-1/16" (with 5-1/2" door prep)
  • Exterior Total Projection: 2-15/16"
  • Exterior Center to Center Grip Range: adjustable 8-3/8" to 9-7/8"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Escutcheon Height: 3-3/8"
  • Exterior Deadbolt Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Top Grip Escutcheon Width: 3"
  • Exterior Grip Height: 12-1/2"
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4" packaged with extra screws to accommodate 2" doors
  • Schlage Camelot Exterior Handleset Specifications (PDF)

When Selecting a Function:

  • Full Dummy Set: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.
  • Single Cylinder: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the handleset latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the inside, a thumbturn unlocks the deadbolt and a knob/lever operates the latch.

Sold Individually
